positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description: Proposed technical feasibility solutions for new functional designs and suggested options for performance improvement. Involved in entirety of software development life-cycle and implementations of projects were written with consideration of functional flexibility for future enhancements. Worked closely with customers getting real-time feedback by phone and/or email while addressing issues/concerns from platform features to data processing. Established compatibility with third party APIs by developing program for modification and integration. Assisted with building and training development team as the company expanded. Reviewed code of colleagues and left constructive feedback on what could be improved or proposing another approach. Often had to set meetings with India team to discuss about projects and upcoming tasks. Debugged problems and corrected issues using web tools and different IDE debugging tools.
positions.insights: Skills: SQL · HTML · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · RESTful architecture

positions.title: Web Development Intern
positions.description: Simplified user interactions with site so actions needed to change listing(s) is significantly less and much more time efficient. Wrote unit tests to check for bugs on web pages testing php backend code. Worked with marketing team to determine UI fixes and changes to site.

volunteerExperiences.description: I volunteered to help others in the early stages of the computer science major. I helped make data structures, algorithms, etc. simpler to understand and helped debug errors in code.
